units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:28">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 36</cite> <he>בו״ד … ק׳ שלו אלא מזכיר ק׳ וכ׳</he> ed. Bub. (not <cite ref="S00742"><he>קטיגמא</he></cite>) when a human being sets a memorial to his name, he mentions first his name, and then his creation, but not so the Lord, he records his creation first and then his name, as we read (<cite ref="Genesis 1:1">Gen. I, 1</cite>), ‘In the beginning created God;’ <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:12">Gen. R. s. 1</cite> (misplaced and curtailed, v. Ar. s. v. <cite ref="S00744"><he>קטיזמא</he></cite>); Tanḥ. ed. Bub.

<cite ref="Genesis 4">B’resh. 4</cite> <he>קטומה</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Genesis 5">ib. 5</cite> <cite ref="E00316"><he>הטיומא</he></cite> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 162">Yalk. Sam. 162</cite> <cite ref="S00742"><he>קטיומא</he></cite> (corr. acc.).—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 5:5:3">Y. B. Kam. V, 5ᵃ</cite> top [read:] <he>רשב״ג אומר אומר קְטִיזְמִי היא זו</he> (not <he>קוט׳</he>) R. S. b. G. says, he (the purchaser of a breeding slave) may say, it is my creation (i.e. damages for injury to his slave’s embryo belong to him).
